en: Context engineering then kind of builds up
on prompt engineering and is the
art, if you want to call it like this,
of giving the model the right information to
generate a good answer. Now, I'll be honest,
in the past we used to just talk about
prompt engineering. Then somebody decided
that we also need context engineering.
I typically always meant context engineering
too when I talked about prompt engineering.
But technically, if you want to
differentiate the two, the difference that
context engineering is all about ensuring
that you're sending the right documents, the
right instructions, the right tools, maybe
if you're building a software on top of AI,
for example, to the model so that it can
complete its job in the best possible way.
It's simply about ensuring that with your
prompt and all the other information that's
available to the model,
you get the response you need or you get the
result you need.
That's what context context engineering
means.
